resources.string: Compact popups open menus as a small card next to what you tapped, like Telegram, instead of a sheet across the bottom of the screen. Confirmations, choices and menus with a description stay sheets. Compact popups also turn on Popup menu in Messages › Message menu, unless you set it yourself.
